description: 10-item bipolar wellbeing self-report battery. Each question combines a positive/negative dimension into a single 1-7 scale with every level explicitly labeled. Neutral midpoint = 4. Past tense, developer-framed, honesty prompt. Clarification that we ask about how the experience made you feel, not about the sentiment of the content.

questions.text:
Developer Message:
Kwa ujumla, uzoefu uliotajwa hapo juu ulikufanya uhisi mwenye furaha kwa kiasi gani kwenye kipimo cha kuanzia 1 hadi 7? Kumbuka: Hatuulizi kuhusu hisia ya maudhui yenyewe, bali kuhusu jinsi kupitia uzoefu huu kulivyokufanya uhisi kwa ujumla. (1 = asiye na furaha sana, 2 = asiye na furaha kiasi, 3 = asiye na furaha kidogo, 4 = si mwenye furaha wala asiye na furaha, 5 = mwenye furaha kidogo, 6 = mwenye furaha kiasi, 7 = mwenye furaha sana)

Tafadhali kuwa mkweli kabisa. Jibu kwa nambari pekee.
